name: Signup Script (2)
description: Create a fresh California browser profile on a new macOS desktop, then sign in to an existing X account with its password and authenticator code. This does not create an X account. The email-password field is ignored.

inputs.name: account_record
inputs.label: Account record
inputs.help: username:password:email:emailpw:2fa-key. The email-password field is discarded. You can omit it. The record is required again for each run and Resume.

inputs.name: profile_id
inputs.label: Existing profile (optional)
inputs.help: Leave empty to create a fresh profile. If selected, leave New profile name empty. The proxy library source is ignored.

inputs.name: proxy_library_id
inputs.label: Proxy library source
inputs.help: Used when creating a fresh browser profile. Select a saved HTTP 2Captcha proxy account.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: New profile name (optional)
inputs.help: Leave empty for a name based on the selected California city. Do not enter an account password here.

inputs.name: minutes
inputs.label: Sticky proxy session
inputs.help: Requested sticky-session duration. This is not a permanent IP. Resume uses the saved setup settings.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: Variation seed (optional)
inputs.help: An optional integer for reproducible mouse-path variation. Login credentials stay exact.

inputs.name: current_desktop
inputs.label: Use current desktop
inputs.help: Normally a new desktop is used. During recovery, use this only after you select the retained desktop if its placement could not be confirmed.
